character: 80 km in the Ariege Pyrenees. Natural thermal hot springs in Ax-les-Thermes village (rue des Thermes, free public, 36-78C).
name: Ax 3 Domaines
description: 95km of pistes, 22 lifts, across 3 sectors (Bonascre, Saquet, Campels) above the thermal town of Ax-les-Thermes in the Ariège Pyrenees. Known for: the free natural thermal hot springs in Ax (36-78°C on rue des Thermes), being the largest ski resort in Ariège, and the unique snake gliss (4.5km toboggan descent).

suitability.families: Good — Ax thermal baths are a unique family draw
